source.check: 'There will be no contests for membership of Antrim County Council, all the persons nominated being returned unopposed' (Belfast News-Letter, 21 May 1952, p. 10); the printed list names 21 members and the two divisions it omits are filled from the members returned in 1949 and 1955.

note: Triennial election of Antrim County Council; nominations received on 20 May 1952, withdrawals to 21 May, and polling, where necessary, on Thursday 5 June 1952 ('polling day will be Thursday, June 5', Belfast News-Letter, 21 May 1952, p. 10). There was no contest in any Antrim division, so no poll was held in the county. No party labels were printed. The returning officer's notice of result (Belfast Telegraph, 6 June 1952, p. 6) lists each division with its candidate, and the retiring members deemed re-elected where there was no nomination (Ballyclare and Glenarm). Returned unopposed.
